tools.name: search_models
tools.description: Filter the published catalog (substring search, not a benchmark or guarantee of free access). Returns exact provider/model slugs for subsequent tools, conditions, dates and source links.

tools.name: get_provider_guide
tools.description: Read official application links, payment/identity conditions and existing application steps for a published provider. No signup or key generation is performed.

tools.name: list_price_references
tools.description: List dated price reference IDs and billing scenarios for estimate_cost. This is a limited reference set, not complete market coverage or live quotes.

tools.name: estimate_cost
tools.description: Estimate USD cost for ONE listed priceId and its exact billing scenario. inputMillion/outputMillion are millions of tokens, not individual tokens. Not a live quote, free quota calculation, or charge.

tools.name: get_route_status
tools.description: Read existing sampled checks for public catalog routes. No new checks run. Missing/stale evidence must not be interpreted as uptime or an outage. provider/model use catalog slugs.

tools.name: export_keyless_config
tools.description: Render a keyless config for 1–5 exact catalog providerSlug/modelSlug pairs. Only environment variable references are returned. No keys, prompts, network calls, or file writes. Review compatibility before using.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "export_keyless_config" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Render a keyless config for 1–5 exact catalog providerSlug/modelSlug pairs. Only environment variable references are returned. No keys, prompts, network calls, …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "export_keyless_config" references sensitive artifacts (environment variable). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Render a keyless config for 1–5 exact catalog providerSlug/modelSlug pairs. Only environment variable references are returned. No keys, prompts, network calls, …
